description: Defines a JSON converter class 'StreamImplConverter' for serializing and deserializing stream-related objects in the Orleans.Streaming.JsonConverters namespace, utilizing Newtonsoft.Json for JSON handling and working with Orleans runtime components.

classes.name: StreamImplConverter
classes.description: A custom JSON converter to serialize and deserialize Orleans stream implementation objects, handling StreamId, provider name, and rewindability metadata.

methods.name: StreamImplConverter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the converter with an Orleans runtime client.

methods.name: CanConvert
methods.description: Determines if the converter can handle the specified type, specifically generic streams or stream implementations.

methods.name: ReadJson
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data into a stream implementation object, reconstructing the stream with its metadata.

methods.name: WriteJson
methods.description: Serializes a stream object into JSON format, including its ID, provider name, and rewindability.
